description.value: An adult entertainment bar and lounge on Whalley Boulevard in Surrey operating as an exotic show lounge with a rotating weekly lineup of performers. The venue offers VIP experiences and special events nights. It is a late-night destination operating into the early morning hours.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record lists this as 'Champagnes Exotic Show Lounge' but the linked website (shakerzshowlounge.com) is for 'Shakerz Show Lounge' at the same address — likely a rebrand of the same physical venue. The website confirms the address as 10458 Whalley Blvd, Surrey BC, contradicting the OSM community field which lists 'North Vancouver'. No amenity information (bike parking, washrooms, water, Wi-Fi, etc.) is present in either the OSM tags or the minimal website content.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Champagnes Exotic Show Lounge' but the linked website is branded 'Shakerz Show Lounge' — likely a rebrand; the OSM name may be outdated.
Community field says 'North Vancouver' but the address (10458 Whalley Blvd) and website both place this in Surrey, BC.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible bar at a confirmed physical address; a late-night stop along the Whalley Boulevard corridor that a touring cyclist might use.
